_note: Series-wide item types. kind is elixir | charm | hint | note | currency | plant | notebook | tool. An optional 'icon' names a placeholder icon drawn in code (scenes/foraging/item_icon.gd). heal_units is in half-hearts (rules.json half_units_per_heart). Items with usable false cannot be used yet. kind plant is a plant a finished word gives (view-only in the backpack); kind notebook is the 수첩, the only item that opens a view (the notes inside it). kind tool (Prompt 9c) is a breakable grabbing tool for the animal scene: uses = grab attempts before it breaks, reach_m = how far it reaches (0 = bare-hand reach), targets = animal classes it works on (ground | small | flyer | water, from animals.kinds[].class), windup_s = seconds between the press and the grab landing, quirk = optional rule: {kind, cost} costs that many uses on that animal kind, {kind, breaks} breaks at once on it, {gloves} works through bare-hand grabs. Tool instances are kept apart from the counted items (scripts/tool_belt.gd). Note items are not listed here: Content registers them from data/notes/*.json (kind note).
